kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَعْقَعَ • (qaʕqaʕa) Iq (non-past يُقَعْقِعُ (yuqaʕqiʕu), verbal noun قَعْقَعَة (qaʕqaʕa))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Reduplicated onomatopoeic root. Compare غَرْغَرَ (ḡarḡara, “gurgle”), وَسْوَسَ (waswasa, “whisper”), قَمْقَمَ (qamqama, “grumble”).
g: to clatter, to clank, to rattle

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَعْقَع or قُعْقُع • (qaʕqaʕ or quʕquʕ) m (plural قَعَاقِع (qaʕāqiʕ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Reduplicated and onomatopoeic, from the sound a magpie makes.
